title: `DAYOFWEEK` and `WEEK` follow session parameters; the ISO forms do not
verdict: `DAYOFWEEK` Sunday 0 under `WEEK_START` 0; sverify writes the ISO forms
description: Under the defaults (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0), `DAYOFWEEK` and `EXTRACT(dow …)` count from Sunday = 0, `WEEK` is ISO (`2021-01-01` is week 53 of 2020), and `DATE_TRUNC('WEEK')` goes to Monday. Both parameters change these. `DAYOFWEEKISO`, `WEEKISO` and `YEAROFWEEKISO` are ISO whatever they say.
Dates are proleptic Gregorian: `1582-10-10` exists. Parts before 1970 and in year 1 are right.
reference: `week_numbering`: ISO weeks, floor before 1970. sverify's SQL writes `DAYOFWEEKISO`, `WEEKISO`, and truncates to Monday itself (`writer-date-part`, `writer-date-trunc`).

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake through the Snowflake CLI (Snowflake characterization session)

evidence.sql: SELECT d, dayofweek(d), dayofweekiso(d), week(d), weekiso(d), yearofweek(d), yearofweekiso(d), date_trunc('WEEK', d), dayofyear(d), extract(dow FROM d), extract(dayofweek_iso FROM d) FROM (VALUES ('2021-01-01'::DATE), ('2021-01-03'::DATE), ('2021-01-04'::DATE), ('2024-12-30'::DATE), ('2026-11-05'::DATE), ('1969-12-29'::DATE)) AS s(d) ORDER BY d

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_snowflake` runs each query through `snow sql` (Snowflake CLI 3.32.1) on an X-Small warehouse, Snowflake 10.40.102, with the session's `TIMEZONE` set to UTC and `USE_CACHED_RESULT` off; every other parameter is the account's default, recorded in the header of probes.json (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0, `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING` LAST, `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The inputs are literal `VALUES`, except the `sample-*` probes, which read TPC-H's LINEITEM (6,001,215 rows) in SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.
